name: v221_icapt_annual_quarterly_balance
hypothesis: The annual invested-capital productivity version had enough Fitness but weak sub-universe robustness, while the quarterly version had strong LSUS but lower Fitness. A balanced annual/quarterly productivity expression may retain the annual return signal while inheriting quarterly robustness.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.52, 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt), 126), subindustry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales / abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt), 126), subindustry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / abs(fnd6_newqv1300_icaptq), 126), subindustry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(fnd6_newqv1300_icaptq / assets, 126), 126), industry) + 0.110 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fnd6_newa2v1300_wcap / assets, 126), industry) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Main v221 repair: annual return signal plus quarterly LSUS stabilizer. Reject if LSUS fails or Fitness remains below 1.10.

name: v221_icapt_largecap_stability
hypothesis: Raising the cap gate should reduce the TOP1000 fragility seen in rKon7GNd. If the signal is real among larger names, annual invested-capital productivity should keep Fitness while LSUS improves.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.62, 0.310 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt), 126), subindustry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales / abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt), 126), subindustry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fnd6_newqv1300_wcapq / assets, 126), industry) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.050 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Large-cap / lower truncation LSUS repair. Kill if return and Fitness collapse.

name: v221_icapt_market_neutral
hypothesis: If industry neutralization removes too much of the capital-efficiency spread, MARKET neutralization may preserve cross-industry capital productivity while still controlling net exposure. This tests a real setting-level robustness change from v220.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.52, 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt), 126), subindustry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales / abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt), 126), subindustry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(fnd6_newqv1300_icaptq / assets, 126), 126), industry) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fnd6_newa2v1300_wcap / assets, 126), industry) + 0.070 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Setting-level repair, not a sibling if LSUS/Fitness improve materially. Strict corr gate still required.
